thread:
Maya (docs): FYI: Draft of the release notes for tomorrow's rollout is up. Need quick QA — especially the SDK examples and known-issues section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825
Sam (eng): Looking now. Which examples are most likely to break — streaming or embeddings?
Maya (docs): Main concerns: streaming discontinuities for long system messages (see INCIDENT-892), the JS SDK snippet still uses the old `createStream` API, and a couple of internal docs links are returning 301s.
Luis (sdk): I can update the JS example. Proposed pattern:
```js
const resp = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood/kestrel', messages });
for await (const chunk of resp) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
resp.close();
```
Is that the shape we want?
Maya (docs): Yes — show the `for await` pattern + `resp.close()`. Add a one-line note about browser compatibility (streams vs. Node).
Dana (prod): For the streaming truncation: ops improved fallback behavior but truncation can still happen >32k tokens when prefix cache is enabled. We should add repro steps and a clear workaround.
Sam (eng): I'll draft repro steps (curl + minimal payload) and include log grep lines. Also propose the safe workaround: set `prefix_cache: false` on the route until the full fix lands.
Maya (docs): Perfect. Who can review the PR today? Need one docs + one eng signoff before we merge.
Luis (sdk): I can review the SDK snippet and push a small commit to the PR. Will also add a quick unit test for the new streaming helper.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4825--docs.redwood.ai/whats-new — live for review :white_check_mark:
Sam (eng): Found one broken internal link: `/private/setup` -> now `/private/deploy`. I'll open a redirect PR and add a note in the What's New page.
Maya (docs): Assigning owners: Sam (link fix + repro steps), Luis (SDK snippets + tests), Dana (known-issue wording + ops confirmation). Target merge by 16:00 PT so release email/changelog can go out tomorrow. Ping me if anything blocks.
Luis (sdk): :thumbsup: pushing snippet change now. Also standardizing the Python example to the new single-call pattern.
Sam (eng): Created redirect PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4832 — adds 301->200 redirect header and updates internal links.
Dana (prod): Ops confirmed fallback improvement but not a permanent fix. I'll add the incident link and exact SLO caveat into the known-issues bullet.
Maya (docs): Thanks everyone. After merge I’ll cut the changelog entry and the release brief. If anything looks off in preview, drop it in #eng-oncall and tag me.
